newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia bourse consolidates its upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia bourse consolidates its upward trend.

text.p: Tunis Stock Exchange ended its Thursday session 0.13 percent higher consolidating its upward trend due to increasing liquidity and demand for blue-chip stocks, a stockbroker said.

The all-share index closed at 493.61 points, up from 492.97 points, a bourse official said. The number of shares which exchanged hands more than doubled to 69,978 from 31,946 shares on Wednesday, he said.

"The increasing liquidity and investors demand for blue-chip stocks were behind the bourse index rise. The newly introduced electronic trading system is attracting more traders compared with the past months," a market analyst said.
The 31-share index is expected to go soon beyond the line of 500 points because the market is showing a significant performance, the analyst said.
Banque de Tunisie, one of the country's leading private banks, rose 1.4 percent to close at 73.3 dinars compared with the previous session.
Arab Tunisian Bank closed at 33.58 dinars, up from 31.68 dinars.
National airline Tunis air, which is among the 63 firms to be privatised by end 1997, rose to 19.34 dinars from 19.20 dinars on Wednesday, a broker said.
Total traded volume reached 1.1 million dinars, up from 748,318 dinars over the previous session.
